prompt.description: Text prompt describing the video. Refer to reference media in upload order as @Image1, @Video1, and @Audio1.

reference_audio_urls.description: Up to 5 reference audio clips, used together with reference_image_urls or reference_video_urls. input.prompt: One continuous 30-second story of the same young woman in a yellow raincoat delivering a handwritten letter across a small seaside town at dawn. 0-6s: wide aerial shot of the sleepy harbor town, fishing boats rocking, soft morning light; she rides an old bicycle down a cobblestone hill. 6-12s: tracking shot beside her as she weaves past a fish market, seagulls lifting off, a vendor waves at her. 12-18s: low-angle shot as she climbs a steep stone staircase carrying the bicycle, breathing hard, the letter tucked in her pocket. 18-24s: she knocks on a blue door at the top; an elderly man opens it and she hands him the letter. 24-30s: close-up of the man reading, his eyes filling with tears; he smiles and says softly, "She remembered." Camera slowly pulls back to reveal the sunrise over the sea. Natural ambient sound: waves, gulls, bicycle bell, footsteps, gentle piano music. No subtitles, no on-screen text.

Locked-off time-lapse of the red lakeside cabin: start from the summer evening in the first frame, let snow gradually cover the shore and the wooden dock as the sky darkens, and end exactly on the snowy night with the aurora in the last frame. Soft wind and crackling ice.

@Image1 is the ginger cat. It wears the yellow knitted scarf from @Image2 and is inside the bookstore from @Image3. On a rainy night the cat walks along a bookshelf, jumps down beside a reading lamp, and looks at the camera. Match the slow, cozy rhythm of @Audio1. No subtitles.
